metadata.title: Independent Comparator receipts for OpenAI's 7/8 zero-free theorem and Anthropic's zeta23, with the MNF.RH Lean library judged on each
metadata.description: Five receipt bundles and the pinned kits that produced them. On one laptop, under a sandboxed protocol with every input held to a sha256, Comparator (the Lean FRO's proof judge) re-checked (1) OpenAI's Lean 4 theorem that the Riemann zeta function has no zeros with real part above 7/8 (github.com/openai/math at commit adc7f124; verdict PASS, cold run, Lean kernel, 2026-10-27) and (2) Anthropic's Lean 4 formalization zeta23 of Alpoege and Furman's theorem that more than two thirds of the zeta zeros are simple and on the critical line, 17 statements (github.com/anthropics/formal-math at commit 16a5ce41; verdict PASS, cold run, Lean kernel and NanoDa, 2026-10-28). On top of each verified tree, the depositor's consolidated Lean library MNF.RH was judged by Comparator as a further run with its own challenge file and every definition compared by body: 40, 43 and 87 theorems on OpenAI's tree (v1, v2, v3; ACCEPTED 2026-10-28/29) and 62 theorems on Anthropic's tree (ACCEPTED 2026-10-29). The library re-expresses the Riemann Hypothesis (the MNF spectral-gap hypothesis at any threshold above 3/8 is RH; at every threshold it is a zero-free strip next to the critical line), restates zeta23's Theorems A to D over its own definitions, and proves, with two literature facts as explicit hypotheses, that a gap at any positive threshold forces density one of the zeros onto the line. The record claims no proof of RH or of the simple-zeros conjecture and combines nothing from the two external results. Every hash is re-derivable with the included verify_deposit.sh; DEPOSIT_MAP.md is the register of what is proved, conditional, open and withdrawn.
metadata.notes: The theorems under test belong to OpenAI and to Anthropic/Alpoege-Furman and are credited as such; this record is an independent repetition of checks their authors report, not a first verification. Warm/cold status, kernels used and every deviation are stated in each receipt. The Lean additions of 2026-10-28/29 and the scripts were produced with Claude Code under the depositor's direction; the Sturm-Liouville file is co-authored by Aristotle (Harmonic). Zenodo's concept DOI should be added to README-DEPOSIT.md after first publication; do not regenerate any add-on tarball for that edit.
